name: poll-platform
description: PollWave — Private-by-Design Community Polls and Elections

scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml down && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml down
